## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Mar 14, 2026 - Jul 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users report reliability problems. This points to quality gaps competitors can exploit.

         **Review examples:**
            1. ___Mari__, Jul 19, 2026, 1/5: "Around two weeks ago, the synchronization with Google Calendar stopped working for all my reservations . I see the confirmation pop-up, but no event is added to my Google Calendar. In addition, I can no longer see any of my friends in upcoming reservations, when they have booked the same reservation. These issues are extremely frustrating and cause a great deal of inconvenience. I already contacted support, but it was not helpful. It seems that even after requesting to speak with a human, an AI bot continues the conversation instead. That’s very disappointing."
            2. _Peachromero_, Mar 14, 2026, 4/5: "It works like heaven 2 me but it’s been having lots of bugs and I haven’t been able to leave reviews for a while now! Besides that I love it"

## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Pricing and paywall.**
      4 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Jul 7, 2026 - Jul 23, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _JaqSanMarc_, Jul 23, 2026, 1/5: "Would not take my payment information for the free trial! Called my bank and when it finally went through, It said my free trial was not eligible to use and that i have to pay! Ive never signed up for this app! This is bs! One hour talking to my bank to let the payment through for nothing!"
            2. _isaabelliy_, Jul 8, 2026, 1/5: "I previously used ClassPass and loved it, so I was excited to come back when I received an offer for a 14-day trial for $1. Instead, it turned into one of the most frustrating customer experiences I’ve had. After accepting the offer, I was told my trial had already ended and that I needed to purchase an $89 membership to book classes. I paid for the membership, and I still couldn’t book any classes. I ended up canceling and requesting a refund because I had paid for a service I couldn’t use. Customer support’s solution? They offered to restore my unused trial credits—but only if I paid for another membership first. They also refused to honor the promotional discount I had asked about, citing company policy. At no point did anyone explain why I couldn’t use my paid membership in the first place. I understand that companies have policies, but when a customer pays for a service they can’t access, the response should be more than “pay us again, and we’ll restore your credits.” It’s disappointing because I genuinely enjoyed ClassPass before this. Unfortunately, this experience has completely changed my opinion of the company. I hope they improve both their account systems and the way they handle customer issues, because this was far from the experience I expected."
            3. _Harmun123_, Jul 22, 2026, 3/5: "I’ve loved this app for a long time. I recently wanted to switch my plan for the 8 credit one instead of the 18 credit one. I have 31 unused credits and I realized I don’t need the 18 credits per month. It says if I switch my plan, only 10 of these unused credits will roll over- forcing me to stick with my current plan unless I want to lose good money I paid for those credits. This is greedy and not fair. I paid money per month for those credits and now I would need to lose them in order to pay less every month."
